link.title: Pair the {name}
link.description:
Select **Submit**, then accept Home Assistant's access request on the Freebox display (right arrow).

Then, in Freebox OS (Freebox settings › Access management › Applications), grant the app the **Freebox settings modification** permission for reboot and Wi-Fi, , **Calls manager access** for the call log and **Parental control access** for the profiles.

block_internet.name: Block Internet access
block_internet.description: Cuts Internet access for the devices of a parental control profile, for a while or until further notice.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: How long to block. Without a duration, until access is allowed again.

allow_internet.name: Allow Internet access
allow_internet.description: Restores Internet access for a parental control profile, even if its schedule blocks it.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: How long to allow. Without a duration, until the next change planned by the schedule.

resume_schedule.name: Resume schedule
resume_schedule.description: Ends a manual pause or allowance: the profile's schedule applies again.

not_a_profile.message: {entity_id} is not the Internet access of a parental control profile
